notes.title: Demov available
notes.content:
Playable demo available now!

In the demo, you'll play a small portion of the first chapter of "A Life's Journey" to get to know the basic mechanics, the soundtrack (I love awesome battle music!), and the mood of the game.
Playtime is approximately 2-4 hours, depending on your desire to grind and your drive for perfectionism. ;)

Steam Achievements are not included in the demo version. However, there is an integrated achievement system as a taster.

The save games will most likely [b]not[/b] be transferred to the full version. Since I'm currently working on some plugins, events, and balancing, among other things, there's a high probability that the save game might no longer be compatible with the full version...but maybe it will be, I'm not promising anything.

English is currently only available [b]for testing [/b] via options.

I'd be happy to receive constructive feedback via the Community Hub!
